title: Modularity of elliptic curves over imaginary quadratic fields
exact_target: For every elliptic curve E over every imaginary quadratic field K, is its compatible system of first-etale-cohomology representations realized by a weight-zero GL2 automorphic representation with matching local Weil-Deligne data at every finite place and the expected complex-place parameter, with cuspidality for non-CM curves and automorphic induction or isobaric summation in CM cases?
